instructionsEn: Enter your EVC Plus number. You will get a push prompt to approve the payment.
instructionsSo: Geli lambarkaaga EVC Plus. Waxaad heli doontaa fariin aad ku ansixiso lacag bixinta.

instructionsEn: Enter your eDahab number. You will get a push prompt to approve the payment.
instructionsSo: Geli lambarkaaga eDahab. Waxaad heli doontaa fariin aad ku ansixiso lacag bixinta.

instructionsEn: Enter your Safaricom number. Approve the STK push on your phone.
instructionsSo: Geli lambarkaaga Safaricom. Ka ansixi codsiga taleefankaaga.

instructionsEn: You will be redirected to Telebirr to complete the payment.
instructionsSo: Waxaa lagu gudbin doonaa Telebirr si aad lacag bixinta u dhammaystirto.

instructionsEn: You will be redirected to a secure card checkout.
instructionsSo: Waxaa lagu gudbin doonaa bog ammaan ah oo kaadhka lagu bixiyo.

instructionsEn: Pay in cash when your order is delivered or collected.
instructionsSo: Lacagta bixi marka dalabkaaga la keeno ama aad qaadato.
